nodes.label: Massive spin-1/2 particle
nodes.def: Wigner class m > 0, s = 1/2 (t, tau, mu, Lambda).

nodes.label: Massive spin-1 particle
nodes.def: Wigner class m > 0, s = 1 (W, Z, J/psi).

nodes.label: All spin states of one particle
nodes.def: Density operators on C^(2j+1) of a particle at rest; data Bloch vector v = kappa r for j = 1/2.

nodes.label: Steered ensemble
nodes.def: States of particle A conditioned on the recorded decay direction of particle B (remote preparations).

nodes.label: Separable states
nodes.def: Convex hull of product states.

nodes.label: Entangled states
nodes.def: Non-separable bipartite states.

nodes.label: Unpolarised pair states
nodes.def: Two spin-1/2 particles with vanishing single-particle polarisation; correlation matrix C.

nodes.label: Isotropic spin-1 pair states
nodes.def: v |singlet><singlet| + (1-v) 1/9 for two spin-1 particles.

nodes.label: Top-pair spin state
nodes.def: Spin state of a t tbar pair at fixed kinematics.

nodes.label: Hyperon-pair spin state
nodes.def: Lambda anti-Lambda from e+ e- -> J/psi at production angle theta.

nodes.label: Observable postulate, Born rule
nodes.def: Hermitian observables and the Born rule.

nodes.label: Charged-current vertex
nodes.def: (g/sqrt2) W_mu J^mu_CC + h.c.

nodes.label: Universal V-A current-current term
nodes.def: (G_F/sqrt2) J_mu J^mu dagger.

nodes.label: Muon-decay contact term
nodes.def: (G_F/sqrt2)(nubar_mu gamma^mu mu)(ebar gamma_mu nu_e) with V-A structure.

nodes.label: Neutral-current vertex
nodes.def: (g/cos theta_W) Z_mu J^mu_NC.

nodes.label: Quantum theory
nodes.def: Complex quantum theory.

nodes.label: Classical probability (simplex)
nodes.def: Simplicial state space with all response functions.

nodes.label: Decay polarimeter
nodes.def: The measurement a decay implements on the parent spin: one fixed SU(2)-covariant POVM E_w(q) = (d/4pi) R_q D_w R_q^dagger with kernel w (helicity weights of the recorded direction).

nodes.label: Spin-1/2 polarimeter
nodes.def: E(q) = (1 + kappa q.sigma)/4pi; kappa is the spin analysing power.

nodes.label: Spin-1 polarimeter
nodes.def: Kernel (w+, w0, w-); eta1 = w+ - w-, eta2 = 1 - 3 w0.

nodes.label: Recorded-outcome hidden-variable model
nodes.def: Local hidden-variable model of single-setting data whose hidden variables are the recorded outcomes (Kasday; Abel-Dittmar-Dreiner).

nodes.label: Noncontextual ontological model
nodes.def: Finite ontic set, convex-linear epistemic states and response functions that respect all operational equivalences of the fragment (simplex embedding).

nodes.label: Mutual tomographic completeness
nodes.def: The accessible states and effects span each other's dual space; operational equivalences are then those read off the data.

nodes.label: Parity-violating decay asymmetries
nodes.def: Angular asymmetries in weak decays (60Co, muon decay).

nodes.label: Decay-angle distribution
nodes.def: p(q) = Tr[rho E_w(q)] of one particle; multipole coefficients.

nodes.label: Joint decay-angle distribution
nodes.def: (4pi)^2 p(qA,qB) = 1 + a.qA + b.qB + qA^T c qB; raw coefficients (a, b, c).

nodes.label: Opening-angle coefficient D
nodes.def: D = -3 <cos phi> = -tr(c)/3.

nodes.label: Raw-PPT test
nodes.def: rho_raw = (1/4)(1 + a.sigma x 1 + 1 x b.sigma + sum c_ij sigma_i x sigma_j) and its partial transpose are positive semidefinite; for a = b = 0: ||c||_1 <= 1.

nodes.label: Noncontextuality inequalities / simplex-embedding LP
nodes.def: Linear programme deciding simplex embeddability of a fragment.

nodes.label: Entanglement witness / PPT
nodes.def: Witness operators and the PPT test on the state.

nodes.label: Spin-1 region test
nodes.def: (eta1, eta2) outside R (all states) or the product of ratios outside R2 (pair, one decay each).

nodes.label: Vector analysing power bound
nodes.def: |kappa_1| > xi_2j with xi_n the largest Gauss (n even) or Gauss-Radau (n odd) node.

nodes.label: Generalized contextuality
nodes.def: No noncontextual ontological model of the accessible fragment exists.

nodes.label: Bell inequality violation
nodes.def: No local hidden-variable model of a multi-setting behaviour.

nodes.label: EPR steering
nodes.def: No local hidden-state model of an assemblage.

routes.statement: For [ubar_2 gamma^mu P_L u_1(s)][ubar_3 gamma_mu P_L v_4] with massless 2,3,4: sum |M|^2 = 8 ((p1 - m s).p4)(p2.p3).

In the parent rest frame (p1 - m s).p4 = m E4 (1 + s.q): recording the direction of fermion 4 (charged lepton or down-type quark of a top decay) is the rank-one covariant effect (1 + q.sigma)/4pi, kappa = +1, at every value of the other variables.

Three-body V-A decay with fermion 3 recorded (electron of mu decay, charged lepton of leptonic tau decay): effects x^2[(3-2x) - (2x-1) q.sigma]; direction only: |kappa| = 1/3; with the energy recorded the sharpest effect has |kappa| = 1.
t -> b W, narrow width, m_b = 0, b direction: kappa_b = -(xi-2)/(xi+2), xi = m_t^2/m_W^2; |kappa_b| > 1/3 iff m_t > 2 m_W.

Neutrino or up-type-quark direction: kappa_nu = [(xi-1)(xi^2-11xi-2)+12 xi ln xi]/[(xi+2)(xi-1)^2]; quadrature of the matrix element reproduces it and the published leading-order values; kappa_nu = -0.336 at the PDG 2026 masses, |kappa_nu| = 1/3 at m_t = 173.0 GeV.
Rotational covariance of the decay and the Born rule give E(q) = (d/4pi) R_q D R_q^dagger with D >= 0, Tr D = 1, [D, J_z] = 0.
Spin 1: R_q D_w R_q^dagger = 1/3 + (eta1/2) q.S + (eta2/6)(3 (q.S)^2 - 2); symbol of sigma = (1/3, p, A): 1/3 + (eta1/2) p.q + (eta2/2) q^T A q.
First moment of the polarimeter: int q E_w(q) dq = kappa_1 J/(j+1); the coefficient of P.q in 4 pi p(q) is 3 j kappa_1/(j+1).

Two decays: (4pi)^2 p = 1 + a.qA + b.qB + qA^T c qB with a = kappa_A B_A, b = kappa_B B_B, c = kappa_A kappa_B C; rho_raw = (D_kA x D_kB) rho; a sign flip of one analysing power is a partial transpose up to a local unitary.
D = -3 <cos phi> = -tr(c)/3.
Back-edge: conditioning on the direction recorded by the partner polarimeter prepares the state of A with data Bloch vector v(qB) = (a + c qB)/(1 + b.qB).
The decay asymmetries of the released graph are first multipoles of the polarimeter: o_wu is the l = 1 coefficient of o-ang1.
A fragment (states Omega, effects E) has a noncontextual model iff id_V = sum_l Z_l g_l with g_l >= 0 on Omega and e(Z_l) >= 0 for all e in E.
With one setting per side the recorded outcomes are themselves local hidden variables.
Single-setting data cannot violate a Bell inequality.
A single-measurement assemblage always has a local hidden-state model (lambda = outcome).
The recorded-outcome model is not noncontextual: outcome functions differing by an l >= 2 harmonic define the same effect and are given different response functions.

Covariant reduction (all multipole ratios nonzero): the fragment (all states, E_w) is noncontextual iff (eta_1, ..., eta_2j) lies in the convex hull of the points m_l(psi, Z) = d Tr(Pi_l[psi psi^dagger] Pi_l[Z])/(2l+1), psi a unit vector, Z unit-trace with nonnegative Husimi function.
Simplex-embedding LPs on finite sub-fragments: infeasible implies contextual; LPs on finite subsets of the dual cones: feasible implies noncontextual.
Polarisation P and analysing power kappa with P|kappa| <= 1/3: explicit four-state (tetrahedral) model.
Polarisation vectors filling an ellipsoid with semi-axes P1, P2, P3: noncontextual iff |kappa|(P1+P2+P3) <= 1 (six ontic states along the principal axes); planar ensembles: P|kappa| <= 1/2.
P|kappa| > 1/3 implies no noncontextual model: 3 = sum_l t_l.b_l <= sum_l |b_l| <= 1/(P|kappa|).
refs: Horodecki, Shor, Ruskai, Rev. Math. Phys. 15, 629 (2003); Ruskai, ibid. 643 (entanglement-breaking threshold 1/3)
Marvian, arXiv:2003.05984 (preparation noncontextuality alone: average gate fidelity <= 3/4, i.e. 1/2)

routes.statement: If the joint data have a noncontextual model then rho_raw and its partial transpose are positive semidefinite.

If rho_raw passes the test, a noncontextual model exists: from a separable decomposition, directly if the coefficient matrix is invertible and after the cone-preserving projections of the range lemma otherwise.

Range lemma: a subspace meeting the interior of the Bloch cone has a projection onto it that maps the cone into itself; a separable decomposition of a singular coefficient matrix can therefore be moved into its range and row space.
Unpolarised pairs, any rank of c: noncontextual iff ||c||_1 <= 1; explicit model with at most seven ontic states from the singular value decomposition.
|D| > 1/3 implies contextual data: <Phi+| rho_raw^T_B |Phi+> = (1 + tr c)/4 and <Psi-| rho_raw |Psi-> = (1 - tr c)/4.
|kappa_A| <= 1/3 or |kappa_B| <= 1/3: the corresponding local map is entanglement breaking, rho_raw passes the test for every state.
Contextual decay data imply an entangled pair state; the converse holds for all states iff |kappa_A kappa_B| = 1.
The test acts on the raw angular coefficients; the entanglement test acts on the coefficients divided by the analysing powers. The two coincide iff |kappa_A kappa_B| = 1.
Two-sided LP bracket of the threshold on random pair states and on the hyperon pair.

Nonnegative quadratic functions on the sphere (Lemma 3): 2/3 + p.q + q^T A q >= 0 on the sphere iff a 4x4 matrix pencil is positive semidefinite, i.e. iff it is a sum of squares of affine functions; moment form: (t, z, N) are moments of a positive measure on the sphere iff [[t, z^T],[z, N]] >= 0 with tr N = t.
Rank-one decomposition lemma (Lemma 3a), checked constructively on random instances.
Support function of the region: h_R(a,b) = max{ b/5 + sqrt(b^2/25 + a^2/3), -4b/5 }; R = conv(ellipse 3 eta1^2 + 25 (eta2 - 1/5)^2 <= 1, apex (0,-4/5)).
Explicit finite noncontextual models (icosahedral orbits of one pair) at the extreme points of R.
For eta2 != 0 the fragment (all spin-1 states, E_w) is noncontextual iff (eta1, eta2) in R.
Independent numerical values of the support function (SDP) and of the boundary (brute-force LP without the covariant reduction).
Exactly degenerate kernel eta2 = 0: noncontextual iff |eta1| <= 2/9 (fragment-relative equivalences); the limit eta2 -> 0 of R gives sqrt2/3.

Maximally entangled pair, one decay on each side: steered states are images of the coherent cone; noncontextual iff (eta1^A eta1^B, eta2^A eta2^B) in R2 = conv(Gamma, mirror image, (0,-4/5)), Gamma(s) = ((2/3)s(2-s), (2/5)s^2), 0 <= s <= 2.
Explicit finite models at extreme points of R2, including the alignment-only point (0, 8/5).

Isotropic state of visibility v: products scale by v; two ideal W decays are contextual iff v > 5/8 (entangled iff v > 1/4); with one Z -> l+ l- decay on a side the data are noncontextual for every v.

Critical visibilities for pairs of kernels: 5/8 (W W), 2/5 (two decays into pseudoscalar pairs; one such decay with a dilepton or W decay); dilepton pairs, W Z and Z Z are noncontextual for every visibility.
Brute-force LP for the pair region.
Refinement of the three LP directions that deviated by more than 0.5 per cent: the deviations shrink with the grids.
If |kappa_1(w)| > xi_2j the spin-j polarimeter is contextual on all states.
xi_1 = 1/3, xi_2 = 1/sqrt3, xi_3 = (1+sqrt6)/5, xi_4 = sqrt(3/5); extremal polynomials attain them.

The bound is the supremum: the kernel D* = (d/4pi) int Q*(q)|q><q| dq, Q* the extremal polynomial, is noncontextual with kappa_1 = xi_2j when its multipole ratios are nonzero (checked for j <= 4); in general by a perturbation.
Pairs of arbitrary spins: a noncontextual model has the form p = sum_l r_l(qA) s_l(qB) with nonnegative polynomials of degree 2jA, 2jB (Prop. 2), hence || <qA qB^T> ||_1 <= xi(2jA) xi(2jB) (Thm 5c).

First-moment bound behind Thm 5: a nonnegative polynomial of degree n on the sphere with unit integral has first moment at most xi_n; random non-zonal instances stay below, the extremal zonal polynomial attains it.
Consistency of the first-moment inequality with the exact criteria: ||c||_1 <= 1 for spin 1/2; v |eta1A eta1B| <= 2/3, the largest abscissa of R2, for the spin-1 pair.
LP value of max |<J>| over operators with nonnegative Husimi function and positivity of the attaining kernels, j <= 4.
ATLAS: D = -0.537 +- 0.002 +- 0.019 (particle level, 340 < m_tt < 380 GeV), folded bound -0.322 +- 0.009; CMS: D = -0.480 +0.026 -0.029 (parton level).
Arithmetic on the quoted numbers: 10.2 sigma (ATLAS, with its folded bound) and 5.1 sigma (CMS, bound -1/3).
Joint angular distribution of e+e- -> J/psi -> Lambda Lambdabar and the fitted parameters alpha_psi, Delta Phi, alpha_-, alpha_+.
With the fitted form: the production state is a valid rank-2 state; ||c||_1 = 1.108 at 90 degrees; rho_raw fails the test for |cos theta| < 0.517 (46% of events).
Leading-order and QCD-corrected analysing powers of top decay products.
tau -> pi nu: kappa = 1; tau -> rho nu (rho direction): (m_tau^2 - 2 m_rho^2)/(m_tau^2 + 2 m_rho^2) = 0.45.
Z -> f fbar: kernel (eta1, eta2) = (A_f, 1) for massless fermions; W -> l nu: (+-1, 1); vector -> two pseudoscalars: (0, -2).

Fermion-pair decays of vector mesons (direction only): J/psi -> Lambda Lambdabar has w0 = 0.151 < 1/5 (contextual on all states); J/psi -> Sigma+ Sigmabar- sits at the boundary w0 = 3/5 within about one standard deviation; psi(2S) -> tau tau lies inside the window.
Separable pair states give noncontextual decay data for all analysing powers: the local scaling maps preserve separability.
The polarimeter is a POVM of quantum theory on C^(2j+1); the released frame node m_A (GEN_HEP) and model node m-quantum (GEN_GPT_Level) are glued here.
Released edge A5 (simplex embedding) is the definition used here.
Released edge A8 (contextuality is a precondition for entanglement) with the measurement fixed to the decay polarimeter: holds for |kappa_A kappa_B| = 1 and fails otherwise (H8).

Two spin-1/2 particles: the joint decay data are noncontextual iff rho_raw and its partial transpose are positive semidefinite; for unpolarised pairs iff ||c||_1 <= 1; |D| > 1/3 implies contextual data.
